ms.report:
To the Catalyst Fund 11 reviewers,
I am pleased to submit the Proof of Achievement for Sync.Land - Milestone 4: Marketplace Updates & API Launch, demonstrating that all milestone outputs have been delivered and all acceptance criteria have been satisfied with verifiable on-web and on-chain evidence. The complete evidence pack for this milestone lives in the GitHub repository at https://github.com/Awen-online/sync.land/tree/main/docs/M4_API.
Every Cardano transaction, policy and asset referenced below is on the Cardano preprod testnet, not mainnet, the same network used for the Milestone 3 demonstration.
Below is the requirement-by-requirement mapping.
OUTPUT 1 - User feedback including surveys and other metrics
Acceptance Criterion satisfied: User feedback is gathered, analyzed, and put into a document.
Evidence:
・SyncLand_User_Feedback_Report_M4.pdf, covering four instrumented feedback channels and the figures read from production on 2026-09-01.
・The report closes a request-to-usage loop inside a single reporting window: the largest feature request in the survey data shipped, and the resulting open briefs board is public at sync.land/briefs

OUTPUT 2 - Updated functionality for the marketplace, including bug fixes
Acceptance Criterion satisfied: Marketplace updates, including bugfixes, are clearly displayed in the documentation.
Evidence:
・SyncLand_Marketplace_Updates_M4.pdf, the changelog for 2026-06-23 to 2026-09-01, with every change carrying the commit hash that implements it.
・Visible in production: sync.land/licensing and sync.land/free-sync-license

OUTPUT 3 - The API module is publicly launched
Acceptance Criterion satisfied: Test case, an external application is able to verify a sync license via public API.
Evidence:
・The successful API request. Public and unauthenticated, openable by a reviewer with no token, account, or contact with us: licenses/12277/verify. Returns "Island Vibe" by Creepzz under the Sync.Land Free Sync License, nft_verified: true, and
